review_candidates.description: Role Summary Specialized Bicycle Components runs its global finance, supply chain, and commerce operations on Oracle. This role owns that platform: its architecture, its security and compliance posture, the Oracle Cloud Services relationship, and the platform work underpinning the migration to Oracle Fusion Cloud Applications. The position combines hands-on engineering with platform ownership. The Principal Engineer remains technically engaged with Oracle 19c and EBS R12.x while setting OCI architecture standards, owning the SOX control environment, directing the Oracle Cloud Services team as a delivery program, and owning the platform work beneath the EBS-to-Fusion migration. Responsibilities Oracle Database and EBS Engineering The Principal Engineer provides technical leadership for Oracle 19c and EBS R12.x across Production, Test, Development, and Disaster Recovery. The work spans highly available architecture built on RAC, Data Guard, RMAN, and ASM; backup, recovery, and business continuity strategy; and the planning and execution of patching, upgrades, cloning, refreshes, and performance tuning. The role establishes the runbooks and operational standards supporting 24x7 availability and leads root cause analysis to reduce recurring incidents. While not performing testing directly, the Principal Engineer is accountable for test coverage and execution ahead of patching and platform changes, and for communicating maintenance windows, change timing, and expected impact across the technology organization. Regular collaboration with Finance, Supply Chain, Security, and Infrastructure teams rounds out the role's cross-functional scope. Thought Leadership and Technology Innovation The Principal Engineer defines and maintains the long-term architecture roadmap for Specialized's Oracle landscape, evaluates emerging capabilities including AI and advanced automation within Fusion, and brings forward proposals ahead of operational demand. The role serves as a technical advisor to Technology leadership and mentors engineers across the organization. Required Qualifications 10+ years of Oracle Database Administration supporting mission-critical enterprise applications, including 8+ years of hands-on EBS R12.x administration. Deep Oracle 19c expertise across RAC, Data Guard, RMAN, ASM, and performance tuning, with hands- on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure experience. Strong Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) platform administration experience, including VCN design, network segmentation, IAM governance, compartment strategy, console administration, and cloud security controls. Strong Linux fundamentals on Oracle Linux or RHEL: shell scripting, SSH and sudo administration, OS performance tuning, and security hardening. Demonstrated program leadership, including planning, dependency tracking, and stakeholder reporting, and experience directing a managed-services vendor in a 24x7 production environment. Working knowledge of SOX ITGC and audit controls, identity and access management, and cloud security practice. Proven ability to communicate maintenance windows, change timing, and platform impact clearly across the technology organization and to business stakeholders. Preferred Qualifications Experience with Oracle Fusion Cloud Applications, particularly an EBS-to-Fusion migration, is the strongest differentiator for this role. Experience designing secure OCI landing zones and enterprise-scale cloud governance models is highly valued, as is a disciplined approach to patch testing and regression validation ahead of production application. Terraform and infrastructure-as-code, Oracle Enterprise Manager, and Exadata or ExaCS are also valued. WebLogic and SOA Suite are being retired from the environment; experience decommissioning them is more relevant than experience operating them. SBC Internal Use OnlySBC Internal Use Only Relevant certifications include OCI Architect Professional, Oracle Database Administration 2019 Certified Professional, Oracle Autonomous Database Cloud Specialist, and Oracle Cloud Applications implementation credentials.
